leadText:
Morgan (Japanese: モンド Mondo) is a character of the day who appeared in The Journalist from Another Region!.

Morgan participated in the Pokémon Sumo Tournament located on Harvest Island. His first opponent was . His was tossed on the ground by Iris's Dragonite, leading to his apparent defeat. However, since put his tail on the ground, the referee disqualified Iris and Morgan was declared the winner of the round. Apparently, he did not make it to the later rounds since the final two s in the competition were and Rodney.
